summary: Command injection via exec() with unsanitized environment variable in URL
failure_scenario: ANALYTICS_HOST=localhost; rm -rf / in .env causes arbitrary command execution when /analyze open runs

summary: Race condition: bot.js and mineflayer velocity plugin both write bot.inConfigurationPhase without coordination
failure_scenario: Server sends start_configuration -> velocity plugin sets flag=true; state changes to play -> bot.js sets flag=false; velocity's 500ms delayed exitConfigurationPhase runs -> physicsEnabled toggles incorrectly, causing position packets during config -> kick

summary: sessionMonteCarlo uses Math.random() directly, making statistical test non-deterministic and unreproducible
failure_scenario: Same analysis on identical data produces different p-values; CI flakiness; unit tests impossible

summary: kellyEfficiency clamps log(1-f) at 0.001 for f>=1, silently corrupting growth rate for all-in bets
failure_scenario: Session with any wager >= balance produces meaningless efficiency value that looks valid but is completely wrong

summary: kellyEfficiency divides by (kellyLogGrowth || 1) but kellyLogGrowth can be negative, flipping efficiency sign
failure_scenario: winRate=0.55 gives kellyOptimal=0.1, kellyLogGrowth≈-0.0012; actualLogGrowth/negative -> negative efficiency -> clamped to 0

summary: opponentClusterAnalysis early return omits opponentsTested field, causing downstream crash in deepAnalysis
failure_scenario: Session with 1 qualified opponent -> opponentClusters.opponentsTested is undefined -> summary shows 'Found undefined opponents'

summary: sessionMonteCarlo runs synchronous 10,000 x N loop blocking event loop for seconds on large sessions
failure_scenario: /analyze json on 5000-flip session -> 50M iterations -> 2-5 second freeze, bot unresponsive

summary: changePointAnalysis scans split points in steps of 5, missing true change points between steps
failure_scenario: Real structural break at flip 23 missed because only splits 15,20,25 tested; p-value at 25 diluted

summary: sessionMonteCarlo continuity correction double-counts ties: uses <= comparison then (count+1)/(iter+1) correction
failure_scenario: Small wagers produce many exact net ties; p-value inflated by ~ties/iterations (~0.001 bias)

summary: SPRT section dynamically enters/exits BH correction family when decision changes, violating FDR assumptions
failure_scenario: At n=500 SPRT excluded (continue); at n=501 SPRT included (reject_fair); all other tests' q-values suddenly inflate
